{{Quote|The order Moff Tyrak signed came from Imperial Major Stanwu. I've heard of him. He is a liaison between the Empire and hired bounty hunters. I will kill him.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:IV" />}}
'''Stanwu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A liaison between the Empire and the hired bounty hunters, he gave the order to execute the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Spar]] on the lies told to him by Mandalorian [[Tayari Rook]], an execution order approved by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]]. Rook presented evidence that Clan Spar reneged on the contract to destroy a transport ship full of young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Stanwu was later visited by the last surviving member of the clan, [[Akaavi Spar]], who interrogated him, but left him alive.<ref name="TOR:IV" />
